package shapes

type Rectangle struct {
	Width  int
	Height int
}

func (r Rectangle) Area() int {
	if r.Width > 0 && r.Height > 0 {
		return r.Width * r.Height
	}
	return 0
}

func classify(score int) int {
	if score > 90 {
		return 3
	} else if score > 50 {
		return 2
	}
	return 1
}

func pick(a, b, c int) int {
	switch a {
	case 1:
		return b
	case 2:
		return c
	default:
		return a
	}
}

func loop(n int) int {
	total := 0
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		if i%2 == 0 || i%3 == 0 {
			total += i
		}
	}
	for total > 100 && n > 0 {
		total -= n
		n--
	}
	return total
}

// A closure assigned to a local variable: its own body must be tracked
// separately from the enclosing function, not folded into it.
func withCallback(n int) int {
	adder := func(a int) int {
		if a > 0 {
			return a + n
		}
		return n
	}
	if n > 0 {
		return adder(1)
	}
	return 0
}

func rawString() string {
	// Backtick-quoted string: its contents must never be scanned as
	// tokens -- "if", "&&", "||" and "?" all appear inside it.
	return `if this && that || other ? were real tokens, this would miscount`
}

type Greeter interface {
	Greet() string
}
